title: Bantuan.Sarawak.News
tagline: Sarawak government assistance, in one directory.
description: Each scheme links to its source.
about_lead: An independent list of state assistance, with official links only.
about_description: Bantuan Sarawak is an independent directory. It links only to official pages. The government does not run this site.

about_sections.title: What this site is
paragraphs: Bantuan Sarawak is an independent directory of government assistance for people in Sarawak. It is a list of schemes, not a news feed. The Sarawak government does not run this website, and neither does any ministry.
This site does not take applications. Each scheme links to the official page that was checked.

about_sections.title: Where the figures come from
paragraphs: Amounts are taken from official pages. If a ringgit figure was not on an official page, it is not shown.

about_sections.title: State schemes
paragraphs: Every scheme in this directory is a Sarawak state programme.
